tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search dealer listings in plain words, optionally near a US zip or city/state. Returns vehicle facts, asking and previous prices, location, seller, page URLs and supported median asking-price comparisons. Comparisons match year, make, model, trim, state, a fixed 20,000-mile band, drivetrain, fuel an

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Full vehicle facts, current/previous asking price, seller, location and page URL, by listing id.

tools.name: market_prices
tools.description: Model asking prices: median, range, listing/dealer counts, weekly/monthly drops, year averages and cheapest cars. Optional state filter. Not a vehicle valuation.

tools.name: price_drops
tools.description: Advertised price drops in the last seven days, largest first. Returns old/new prices and listing URLs. Optional state, city or zip radius.

tools.name: dealer_lot
tools.description: Find a dealer by name, slug or host. Returns inventory count, asking-price range/median, weekly drops, newest cars and page URL.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Everylot used-car listings for use as a research source. Returns document ids, titles and URLs; read one with fetch.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read one document returned by search, by its id, with its full text and source URL.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "search_listings" is 699 chars, far longer than this server's median (128). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
